S1_BASELINE_CONSERVATIVE_TAKER.root_cause_explanation: basis_convergence_pnl_usdt (6.03 USDT) was computed relative to slippage-adjusted entry execution prices rather than benchmark mid prices, embedding -1.4994 USDT of entry slippage inside Basis P&L (true Mid-to-Mid Basis P&L is +7.5244 USDT). Meanwhile, total_slippage_usdt (3.00 USDT) reported the sum of entry slippage (1.4994) + exit slippage (1.5015). Summing the visible table columns subtracted entry slippage twice (1.4994 USDT + -0.0094 rounding residual = +1.49 USDT).

s6_liquidation_forensics.sprint35_text_vs_json_util_explanation: An early interactive check in Sprint 09.35 deducted perp_entry_slippage (0.7501 USDT) from cash collateral before the double-count fix, yielding 104.34% utilization and -15.08 USDT buffer at Bar 5634. After fixing collateral initialization to deduct only entry fees (since slippage is in execution price), the committed Sprint 09.35 JSON report recorded the true close utilization of 104.1113% and -14.3314 USDT buffer.

rules.exchange_specification: Binance USDT-M initial margin = Notional / Leverage (1% to 100% depending on bracket).
rules.simulator_assumption: Explicitly segregated 25% of total capital ($2,500 backing ~$5,000 perp notional = ~2x effective leverage; 10% in stress test).
rules.economic_impact_note: Prevents over-leveraging and ensures strict wallet segregation from Spot holdings.

rules.exchange_specification: Binance BTCUSDT Tier 1 (<50,000 USDT notional) uses 0.40% MMR (0.004) with 0 USDT maintenance amount.
rules.simulator_assumption: Uses a conservative 5.00% MMR (0.05) baseline — 12.5x stricter than Tier 1 exchange minimum — plus 0.40% Tier 1 comparison in sensitivity.
rules.economic_impact_note: Flags margin depletion early (+45% BTC rally under 2x perp collateral) well before bankruptcy price.

rules.exchange_specification: Exchanges trigger liquidation using real-time Mark Price (Spot Index + decaying funding basis).
rules.simulator_assumption: Approximated from authentic 15-minute Perpetual OHLCV Last Traded High and Close prices.
rules.economic_impact_note: Last traded price wicks can exceed Mark Price during squeezes, making authentic perp High a conservative liquidation trigger.

rules.exchange_specification: Isolated margin restricts collateral to position margin; Cross-margin shares available USDT in the Futures wallet (Spot wallet assets excluded).
rules.simulator_assumption: Models three distinct modes: ISOLATED_NO_SUPPORT, ISOLATED_EXPLICIT_CASH_SUPPORT, and HYPOTHETICAL_CROSS_MARGIN_BENCHMARK (Spot BTC strictly excluded).
rules.economic_impact_note: Eliminates the common backtest fallacy of treating Spot BTC as automatic free collateral for USDT-M shorts.

rules.exchange_specification: Binance charges a liquidation clearance fee (1.00%–1.50% of notional) credited to the Insurance Fund if liquidated above bankruptcy price.
rules.simulator_assumption: Charges an explicit 1.00% liquidation penalty on perpetual notional plus taker fee and slippage to unwind the Spot leg, with an intrabar OHLCV uncertainty band.
rules.economic_impact_note: Captures both direct clearance cost and asynchronous Spot unwind slippage risk.
